$comment: Hand-edited: the shapes of page_text.md section 1, and a page's text holding no C0 control but tab and line feed. The rules the schema does not state are the record checks' (RC-220): pages numbered from 1 in order; a range in order, within its page's text, the ranges of one list in increasing order and not overlapping; a jump at a line feed of its page's text; no line ending in White_Space; an element's range within text; cell_columns in order.
title: PageTextDocument
description: A page-text document (page_text.md section 1): the text of one copy of one document as one text extraction gave it, identified by its RFC 8785 hash. It holds the pages of a PDF, or the text and elements of an XML file, never members of both kinds.

copy.description: The SHA-256 of the copy's bytes, written as a record's copy.sha256 is (provenance.md section 4 item 2).

text_extraction.description: The program that wrote the document and its version.

readings.description: Each reading of the copy the extraction made and compared, with the version of each library it reads the file with; the reading whose text the document holds first.

pages.description: For a PDF: every page of the copy, in the order of its file.

text.description: For an XML file: the string value of the document element.

elements.description: For an XML file: every element, the document element first, in document order.

page.description: One page (page_text.md section 1 items 4 to 7): its position in the copy's file, from 1; its visible text, each line but the last ending in U+000A; and five lists, each empty where the extraction finds nothing.

text.description: The page's visible text in reading order, holding no C0 control but U+0009 and U+000A (page_text.md section 1 item 4).

jumps.description: The positions of the line feeds after which reading order moves to another column or region.

element.description: One element (page_text.md section 1 items 8 and 9): its path, the range of text that is its string value (empty for an element with no text), and, for a table cell, the columns it occupies where the extraction knows the file's table model.
